items.title: Introducing 1:1 NAT on AWS Transit Gateway and AWS Cloud WAN
items.summary: Overlapping IP addresses keep networks from connecting. With 1:1 NAT on AWS Transit Gateway and AWS Cloud WAN, each network gets a unique range through native Regional Private NAT Gateway integration, so you don't renumber networks or deploy a separate NAT solution.
items.creator: Shubham Singh

items.title: Building a unidirectional edge layer for third-party connectivity on AWS with Amazon VPC Lattice
items.summary: Building a unidirectional edge layer for third-party connectivity removes a common trade-off. Enterprises need bidirectional service exchange with partners, vendors, and external platforms, without bidirectional network connectivity that broadens exposure. With Amazon VPC Lattice and AWS PrivateLink, you can exchange services for both ingress and egress, without creating a routed network path. The traditional options […]
